name: school-management-system
description: Sri Lanka School Management System — per-school installable application (web + API).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sms/shared && npm run build -w @sms/api && npm run build -w @sms/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sms/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sms/api && npm run typecheck -w @sms/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sms/shared && npm run test -w @sms/shared && npm run test -w @sms/api
